signals.message: Liquid assets cover less than three months of expenses.
More than 70% of holdings are in one asset class.
Debit unusually large relative to its category peers.

recommendations: Confirm client risk tolerance and goals before any allocation decision.
Discuss building liquid reserves toward at least three months of reported expenses.
Review asset-class concentration and discuss diversification after confirming goals.
Verify flagged transaction IDs and supporting records with the client before treating them as suspicious.
Resolve the reported data limitations before finalizing advice.
warnings: CRM context unavailable; confirm risk tolerance and goals manually.
